preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n * m characters representing the coloring of the table.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be an uppercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout[i] == stdout[i + 1] for i in range(len(stdout) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output must contain at least one pair of adjacent cells with the same color.
